note: 30 spoken prompts for the size comparison (plan voice-speech-model 4.1). kind: short, long, numbers, followup (needs the turn named by `after`, in the same conversation), language, tool (Phase 5's tools). `expect`: words the answer should hold (a|b = either).

prompts.text: What is the capital of France?
How many days are there in a week?
What colour do you get when you mix blue and yellow?
Which planet is known as the red planet?
What is the opposite of hot?
Who wrote Romeo and Juliet?
What is the boiling point of water in degrees Celsius?
Name a fruit that is yellow.
I am planning a three day trip to Lisbon in March with my sister. Can you suggest what we should see on the first day, and roughly how long each thing takes?
I have chicken, rice, a tin of tomatoes and some spinach in the kitchen. What could I cook for dinner tonight, and how long would it take?
My laptop has become very slow over the last month. Before I take it to a shop, what are three simple things I could check myself?
Explain in two or three sentences why the sky is blue during the day but turns red at sunset.
I want to start running but I get out of breath after a few minutes. How should I build up over the first four weeks?
What is seventeen plus twenty five?
My train leaves at a quarter past eight and the journey takes ninety minutes. When do I arrive?
Please repeat this phone number back to me: five five five, zero one four two.
Doctor Katarzyna Nowak and Professor Hiroshi Tanaka are visiting on Thursday. Who is visiting?
If a shirt costs forty pounds and is reduced by twenty five percent, what does it cost now?
My name is Brendon and my favourite number is forty two. Please remember that.
What is my favourite number?
I am thinking of adopting a dog called Biscuit.
What was the dog's name again?
Was ist die Hauptstadt von Deutschland?
Quelle est la capitale de l'Italie ?
¿Cuántos días tiene una semana?
Di che colore è il cielo in una giornata di sole?
Qual é a capital de Portugal?
What is on my calendar tomorrow?
What time is it right now?
Do I have anything planned for today?
When am I free tomorrow afternoon?
Search the web for the weather in Tallahassee.
